content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of ad-free, no-in-app-purchase options to choose from.

Apple Arcade is a subscription service great for the whole family, but it isn't the only option. If you're already a Netflix subscriber, your membership already includes a large library of iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription includes a large library of iPhone and iPad games.

Every Netflix plan now includes a large game library covering mobile and TV.

That includes the cheapest tier, "Standard with Ads," at just $8.99 per month.

Whichever Netflix plan you've picked, you can play mobile and TV games for free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

For TV games, Netflix offers a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app turns your phone or tablet into an input device to use with supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to upgrade your mobile gaming experience, a dedicated iPhone game controller is the best option.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app, called Netflix Playground, offering mini-games designed for kids. On top of that, there's Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond the games above, Netflix has over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download them straight from the App Store, then sign in with your Netflix email and password to play.
